app.title: My Family Budget
app.subtitle: Your household finances, offline and multi-currency

spaces.headline: What would you like to manage?
spaces.intro: Two assistants, one account: same login and password, same currencies.
spaces.familyHint: Household accounts, transactions, budgets, savings, debts and financial statements.
spaces.businessHint: Your activity’s revenue, expenses, income statement, cash flow and journal.

common.amountHint: Integers for CFA franc and Naira; decimals allowed for other currencies.
common.name: Name

auth.offlineHint: Offline: you can keep working, sign-in will be requested when syncing.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters

roles.adminHint: Manages members, shared budgets and the household currency
roles.memberHint: Records their own transactions and views allowed data

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.memberHint: List managed on the Members screen.
transactions.memberDefault: Your profile is preselected; you can change it.
transactions.author: Author
transactions.transferHint: A transfer moves money between accounts: it is neither income nor expense.
transactions.businessHint: Attaches the transaction to the activity's financial statements.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.deleteConfirm: Delete this account and its transactions?

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.empty: No budget set for this month

debts.title: Debts & receivables
debts.affectsAccounts: The repayment affects the selected account balance.

converter.title: Currency converter
converter.offline: Offline: converting with the last stored rates.

reports.title: Reports & exports
reports.hint: Exports include transactions converted to the household currency.

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: One JSON file with the whole household (accounts, transactions, budgets, savings, debts, recurring rules, wealth, businesses). Nothing is uploaded: the file stays on your device.
settings.backupConfirm: Restore {{count}} records? Identical records are skipped, the others go back through synchronization; values that differ on the server will raise conflicts to resolve.

backupError.invalid-json: This file is not valid JSON.
backupError.not-a-backup: This file was not produced by Mon Budget Famille.
backupError.unsupported-version: This backup comes from a newer version of the app.
backupError.invalid-content: This backup is incomplete or damaged.

settings.deleteAccountHint: Your memberships are removed and your e-mail address is released immediately. Families where you were the sole member stay recoverable for 30 days IF you set a recovery phrase (resume via /reset), then they are purged; without a phrase they are deleted right away with their data. Families shared with other members are untouched.
settings.deleteAccountType: Type your e-mail address to confirm
settings.deleteAccountError: Could not delete: server unreachable or session expired.

sync.conflictHint: This data was modified on both sides. Choose which version to keep.

errors.unauthorized: Session expired, please sign in again

recurring.title: Recurring transactions
recurring.name: Label
recurring.startHint: Due dates before today are not generated.
recurring.notePlaceholder: Detail copied into each generated transaction
recurring.deleteConfirm: Delete this recurrence? Transactions already generated stay in the history.
recurring.endBeforeStart: The end date must follow the first due date
recurring.hint: Due items are created automatically when the app opens, then every minute. Amounts are converted into the household currency like any other transaction.

statements.title: Financial statements
statements.wealthCurrent: No historical valuation: current amounts (as of {{date}}).
statements.wealthTrendEstimated: Hollow points: estimated value (no earlier valuation).
statements.footnote: Totals consolidated in {{currency}}; account movements stay in their original currency.
statements.footer: My Family Budget — statement generated on {{date}}. Internal management document, not a certified accounting statement.

members.title: Household members
members.name: Name
members.hint: Each transaction can be assigned to a member for the statement breakdown.
members.inviteHint: Generates a single-use invitation code (7 days): the person enters it at sign-up or in “Join a household”.
members.inviteError: Could not generate: check the account (administrator required) and the server.
members.empty: No members yet: add one to assign transactions.
members.unassignedHint: Assign the transactions below: they will appear in the statement's member breakdown.
members.resetHint: Generates a one-time code (30 minutes) for a family member who lost their password; relay it out of band.
members.resetNotFound: No family member with that address.
members.resetError: Could not generate: check the server and your role.

login.title: Sign in
login.name: Your name
login.error: Could not sign in: invalid credentials or server unreachable
login.inviteHint: Paste the code given by the household administrator to join directly as a member.
login.inviteJoin: Already signed in and invited to an existing household?
login.businessIntro: Sign in to reach your quotes, invoices, sales and statements. The details entered here are printed on your documents.
login.familyIntro: Sign in to reach your household accounts, budgets and statements.
login.companyHint: This name is printed at the top of your quotes and invoices.
login.currencyHint: Amounts, quotes and invoices use this currency.
login.activitiesHint: One line per activity. Leave empty to add them as you go.
login.laterHint: Everything can be completed later from Profile and Settings.

join.title: Join a household
join.hint: Enter the 8-character invitation code you received from the household administrator.
join.confirm: Join this household? This device's local data (except the session) is discarded and replaced by the shared household data.

error.format: The code has 8 allowed characters (no I, L, O and no digits 0 and 1).
error.invalid-invitation: This invitation code is unknown or already used.
error.invitation-expired: This invitation code has expired (7 days).
error.invitation-used: This invitation code was already used.
error.network: Could not join: server unreachable or unexpected error.

errorBoundary.title: An unexpected error occurred
errorBoundary.message: Your local data remains stored on this device. You can safely reload the screen.

reset.title: New password
reset.hint: The server does not send e-mail: ask your family's administrator for a one-time code (valid 30 minutes) and set a new password.
reset.done: Password changed: sign in with your new password.
reset.error: Code refused: check the address and the code (auto-capped), and ask for a new one if it expired.
reset.hintPhrase: You saved a recovery phrase in Settings: enter it here to regain access, with no code and no administrator.
reset.errorPhrase: Phrase refused: check the address and the exact phrase saved in your Settings.

recovery.title: Recovery phrase
recovery.hint: If your password is lost, this phrase replaces the administrator's code (no e-mail is sent). It also lets you resume a family whose account was deleted, for 30 days. The server never sees it in clear: write it down physically.
recovery.notSet: No recovery phrase yet: set one now — otherwise, if you lose your password in a solo family, nobody can unlock you.
recovery.label: Recovery phrase (16 characters minimum)
recovery.success: Recovery phrase saved: keep a copy elsewhere (paper or password manager); the server only stores an anonymised hash.

activity.title: My business
activity.lowStockHint: Stock at or below the alert level
activity.quickActions: What would you like to do?
activity.noBusiness: Create your business first to track your sales and expenses.
activity.simplifiedHint: This month’s figures, in plain words. A credit sale is not money received yet.

products.title: My items and services

kind.label: Type
kind.serviceHint: Labour, fitting, repair, hire: a service is billed without stock. It counts neither in stock value nor in restock alerts.

products.historyHint: Every entry and exit, with its date: the stock of a past month no longer changes.
products.name: Product name
products.alertHint: Alert when quantity reaches this level (0 = no alert).
products.emptyHint: Add your items and services: sales, stock and value follow automatically.
products.hint: Stock value is computed at purchase price; services are not included.

projects.title: Jobs
projects.emptyHint: A job gathers its sales, purchases, expenses and deposits so you can see whether it pays off.
projects.hint: A job creates no entry: it labels documents you already recorded. Attach a sale, a purchase, an expense or a deposit to its job in the matching form.
projects.name: Job name
projects.reportHint: Sales and purchases excluding tax; expenses and advances as entered.
projects.reportAllHint: Comparison of projects in progress: sales, purchases, expenses, margin and still to collect.
projects.subject: Subject

trade.stockShort: more than the stock on hand
trade.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? Stock will be restored.
trade.hintSales: Stock is deducted automatically. Any amount still to pay becomes customer credit.
trade.hintPurchases: Stock is increased automatically. Any amount still to pay becomes supplier credit.
trade.linesRequired: Add at least one line with a quantity.
trade.paymentModeHintCash: The full amount is paid today.
trade.paymentModeHintCredit: Nothing is paid today: the balance becomes a supplier debt.
trade.paymentModeHintInstallments: Enter the first instalment; the rest is settled from the supplier record.
trade.supplierContactHint: These details are saved on the supplier record.

parties.exceeds: The amount exceeds the total owed.
parties.deleteConfirm: Archive this record? History is kept.
parties.historyHint: Payments are applied to unpaid documents, oldest first.

advances.title: Advances and deposits
advances.subject: What the advance is for
advances.emptyHint: Track deposits received from customers and paid to suppliers, apart from sales and purchases.
advances.required: Please enter what the advance is for.
advances.hint: A deposit received from a customer is not a sale; a deposit paid to a supplier is not a purchase. Both are tracked separately until delivery.

profile.title: My profile
profile.emptyHint: Add your business name and contact details so they identify your company.
profile.name: Business name
profile.currencyHint: The currency is set in the household settings.
profile.identityHint: This information stays on your devices and syncs with your account.
profile.archiveConfirm: Archive this activity? Its history is kept.

expenses.title: My expenses
expenses.emptyHint: Add your purchases and costs: they are automatically deducted from your earnings.
expenses.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.
expenses.noBusiness: Create your business in My profile first.
expenses.hint: An expense reduces your available money and your earnings, whether paid or on credit.

treasury.title: Cash flow
treasury.intro: Where your money is, what came in, what went out, and what is still to collect or pay.
treasury.accountsHint: Every cash box, bank account or mobile wallet with its real balance.
treasury.noAccounts: No account yet: add a cash box, a bank account or a mobile wallet.
treasury.flowsHint: Each line is counted once only: a stock purchase is never counted again as an expense.
treasury.transfersHint: Move money without income or expense
treasury.settlementsHint: Every collection or payment, with its date, method and the document paid.
treasury.settlementsFromParties: A collection is recorded from the client or supplier card.
treasury.hint: Money available is what you really own; credit is what you are owed or still owe.

documents.footer: Document generated by Mon Budget Famille · Gestion Pro
documents.arabicUsesPrint: In Arabic, use Print then “Save as PDF”: the browser renders the script correctly.
documents.taxRateHint: 0 for no tax. Entered prices are tax-exclusive.
documents.thanks: Please quote the document number with your payment.
documents.paymentTerms: Late payment may incur recovery costs.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.convertTitle: Convert the quote into a sale
quotes.convertHint: Quote {{number}} becomes a sale: that sale is what counts in your figures.
quotes.converted: Sale created from the quote. Find it under Sales and Invoices.
quotes.locked: This quote has already been converted into a sale.
quotes.emptyHint: A quote proposes a price; it counts neither in sales nor in stock.
quotes.hint: An accepted quote becomes a sale in one click. The quote stays available for reference.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyHint: Record a sale: it receives an invoice number automatically.
invoices.hint: Every sale is a numbered invoice. The invoice is not a second accounting document: it is the sale itself.

states.title: Statements
states.intro: Statements ready to print or download, for your records, your bank or an audit.
states.taxNote: Line prices exclude tax; the daily total includes it.
states.stockLedgerNote: Stock at the start of the period: {{opening}}. Every line is read at its own date; the stock of a past month no longer changes when today's stock moves.
states.hint: Each statement is read line by line: a stock purchase is never counted again as an expense.
states.pickClient: No customer yet: create one from “Manage customers and their details”.
states.statementHint: Customer documents and payments, oldest first; the total shows what is still to collect.
states.pickSupplier: No supplier yet: create one from “Manage suppliers and their details”.
states.supplierStatementHint: Supplier purchases and payments, oldest first; the total shows what is still to pay.

balances.title: Statements
balances.taxDueHint: VAT on sales minus VAT on purchases
balances.taxNote: Profit is calculated excluding tax; sales and purchases shown include VAT, which is paid back
balances.stockNote: Goods still in stock are not counted as a cost: only what is sold weighs on profit.
balances.advancesReceivedHint: In the period, not a sale
balances.resultVsCash: Profit is what you earned; money available is what you actually hold. An unpaid invoice raises profit without raising available money.
balances.chartTitle: Sales and costs, month by month
balances.noBusinessHint: Create your business in My profile to see your statements.

income.title: Income statement
income.hint: Revenue and costs excluding tax, net result, VAT to pay back, then what the business owns and what it owes today.
income.goodsHt: Purchases of supplies and goods excluding tax
income.stockNote: Stock left at the end of the period: {{value}} at purchase price. It is deducted from purchases, since it is not sold yet.
income.taxHint: VAT is not income: it is paid back. The result is therefore calculated excluding tax, and only the difference between VAT collected and VAT recoverable remains to be paid.
income.resultHint: Revenue excluding tax minus costs: unpaid invoices still count, because the sale has already happened.
income.balanceHint: What the business owns today (cash, stock, customer credit) minus what it owes suppliers. An unpaid invoice improves the result without bringing in cash.
income.noBusinessHint: Create your business in My profile to see your income statement.
